Plot native Gaussian mixed-model residual autocorrelation against physical lag

etr_plot_functional_mixed_effects_residual_acf.Rd

Preserves mean/min/max physical lag per index lag, pair-count-weighted native trial/participant/overall dependence and any undefined zero-residual-variance autocorrelation. If the actual grid is nonuniform, the source plotting title warns that the x coordinate is mean physical lag. No automatic AR(1) selection, physical-lag binning or Python Axes identity is implied.

Usage

etr_plot_functional_mixed_effects_residual_acf(
    result, level = "overall", curve_id = NULL,
    participant_id = NULL, strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

result

Retained native functional mixed-effects residual diagnostics with physical-lag summaries and within-trial covariance provenance. Strict mode requires diagnostics from an actual native joint Gaussian spline likelihood fit, not a restricted moment model.

level

One of "overall", "participant", "trial".

curve_id

Required source curve ID for trial level; otherwise NULL.

participant_id

Required participant ID for participant level; otherwise NULL.

strict_source_record

Return an inspectable source scientific Matplotlib-equivalent line, horizontal-zero and axes record, without claiming a Python plotting object.

Value

Invisible observed physical-lag and autocorrelation table in default mode; a source-scientific R artist geometry record in strict mode.
